query: Before I submit to NeurIPS, can you go through references.bib and confirm none of the 62 entries are hallucinated? Some were suggested by ChatGPT.
I'm worried a couple of my citations say the opposite of what I claim. Check each \cite in the related work against what the cited paper actually found.
verify references in my thesis chapter, wrong years and arXiv versions vs the published venue especially
Audit the bibliography of my paper on transformer pruning: real papers, right authors, right venue, cited in the right context.
My .bib file is fine, I just need the paper reformatted into the IEEE conference template with the bibliography style they require.
Review my manuscript on vaccine uptake as a peer reviewer would: are the statistics and methods sound?
I need to find 30 good papers on battery degradation modeling and organize them for a literature review.
